champion.builds: THE BEST KLED BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Kled Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Sudden Impact and Deep Ward in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Bloodsong as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Titanic Hydra. For your last 3 items, you should build Black Cleaver, Sterak's Gage and finish with Umbral Glaive. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 55.1% winrate over 89 matches played. Optional Your second option for Kled Support build would be to take Exhaust and Flash as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Press the Attack as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Overgrowth in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Bloodsong, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Titanic Hydra as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Jak'Sho, The Protean, Randuin's Omen and Kaenic Rookern. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 52.0% win rate over 50 matches. Situational Kled Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Kled build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Kled runes page.
